什么是“厌氧消化”处理有机废水并产沼气？

What is anaerobic digestion of organic wastewater producing biogas?

在无氧条件下，微生物把有机物分解成以甲烷为主的沼气和可沉污泥。既净化高浓有机废水（如养殖、食品），又回收能源，是“污染变资源”的典型。
Under anoxia, microbes split organics into methane-rich biogas and settleable sludge. It treats high-strength organic wastewater (livestock, food) while recovering energy—a classic 'pollution to resource'.

什么是“反渗透”（RO），为什么脱盐能耗高？

What is reverse osmosis (RO) and why is desalination energy-intensive?

RO用高压把海水压过仅允许水分子通过的半透膜以去除盐分。克服渗透压和浓水回流需要大量电能，故能耗高；但与热法相比仍更省能。
RO uses high pressure to push seawater through a semipermeable membrane that passes only water, removing salt. Overcoming osmotic pressure and handling brine needs much electricity, so it is energy-intensive—though still less than thermal methods.

污水处理厂里的“活性污泥法”靠什么净化污水？

How does the 'activated sludge' process clean wastewater?

它利用曝气池中大量微生物群落分解有机物，微生物聚成絮体（污泥）并沉降分离，清水排出、剩余污泥再处理。核心是利用“生物”吃掉污染物。
It uses dense microbial communities in an aerated tank to break down organics; microbes clump into flocs (sludge) that settle and separate, releasing clean water while excess sludge is treated. The key is biology eating pollutants.

什么是“水体富营养化”，怎么治理？

What is eutrophication and how is it managed?

氮磷等营养盐过量使藻类暴长、耗氧、鱼类死亡。治理从源头控污（截污、脱氮除磷）、清淤、引水增氧到恢复水生植被多管齐下。
Excess nitrogen and phosphorus cause algal blooms, oxygen depletion and fish kills. Management combines source control (intercept pollution, N/P removal), dredging, aeration and restoring aquatic vegetation.

什么是“人工湿地”污水处理？

What is constructed-wetland wastewater treatment?

人工湿地模拟自然湿地，让污水缓慢流经芦苇等植物和填料，由植物、微生物和基质共同去除氮磷与有机物，运行成本低、景观友好。
Constructed wetlands mimic natural ones: wastewater slowly flows through reeds and substrate, where plants, microbes and media jointly remove nitrogen, phosphorus and organics—low cost and landscape-friendly.
